summary.work_completed: Authored 8 contract-first test cases for FR-UI-003 Ghost Brick Placement Preview across 3 test files (unit + component). Tests define the interface contracts for ghostBrickStore, useGhostBrick hook, and GhostBrick component that the frontend-coding agent must implement.
key_findings: ghostBrickStore must expose setGhostBrick(position, isValid, brickTypeId) and clearGhostBrick() with Zustand
useGhostBrick hook must snap pointer hit to grid (gridSize=1.6), check occupancyMap, and call store — no-op when no brick selected
GhostBrick component must use opacity=0.5, transparent=true; activeColor for valid, #FF0000 for invalid
Ghost mesh MUST set raycast: () => null to exclude from BVH hit-testing
onPointerLeave must call clearGhostBrick() to hide ghost when cursor exits placement surface

recommended_actions: Implement src/stores/ghostBrickStore.ts — Zustand store with position: Vector3|null, isValid: boolean, brickTypeId: string|null, setGhostBrick(), clearGhostBrick()
Implement src/hooks/useGhostBrick.ts — wires R3F onPointerMove/onPointerLeave events to ghostBrickStore; snaps to grid (gridSize=1.6); calls placementEngine.validatePlacement() for occupancy check
Implement src/components/viewport/GhostBrick.tsx — Three.js mesh with MeshStandardMaterial(opacity=0.5, transparent=true); activeColor for valid, #FF0000 for invalid; raycast: () => null
Implement src/components/viewport/PointerEventCapture.tsx — invisible R3F mesh covering ground plane that captures onPointerMove/onPointerLeave and wires to useGhostBrick
Mount GhostBrick and PointerEventCapture inside Viewport.tsx scene graph
Run vitest to confirm all 8 test cases pass (npm run test in frontend/)
